subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should the remaining Google Chat Space drop be fixed in the current service-account webhook path by expanding mention detection and diagnostics, or consolidated into a broader Google Chat Space/thread routing item first?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining gate, but choosing fallback mention semantics or auto-detection changes which shared-space messages can activate an agent and needs maintainer intent plus live Google Chat proof.

options.title: Fix Mention Detection Here
options.body: Keep this issue canonical and implement a plugin-local fix with live Space @mention proof, focused `monitor-access` coverage, and no change to `requireMention` defaults.

options.title: Consolidate With Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining work into a broader Google Chat Space routing issue only if maintainers want one owner for ingress, thread metadata, and follow-up delivery behavior.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Leave behavior unchanged and document `requireMention=false` or exact `botUser` setup, accepting that mentioned Space messages may still be silently dropped in some deployments.

recommendation.title: Fix Mention Detection Here
recommendation.body: Keep this issue canonical and implement a plugin-local fix with live Space @mention proof, focused `monitor-access` coverage, and no change to `requireMention` defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sits across Google Chat access policy, channel activation semantics, and safe defaults, where steipete has the strongest recent history.
